supporting_observations.claim: The repeated connections during the alert window were CONNECT requests to update.chartmate-imaging.com, occurring from 13:37:44 through 14:07:42 UTC at roughly five-minute intervals.

Endpoint network events associate these repeated proxy connections with C:\Program Files\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe (PID 6564); the process was observed starting before the first such connection and exiting shortly after the last.
The observed updater path and destination match the inventory’s approved ChartMate updater and its expected update host and approximate five-minute check cadence.
The endpoint’s recorded outbound connections in these examples are to the explicit proxy at 10.30.20.30:8080, and the proxy records the corresponding ChartMate HTTPS CONNECT destinations.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT tunnels and connection metadata, not the encrypted application content.
The supplied records cover the stated review window but do not establish whether other activity occurred outside it.
claims_not_established: The logs do not establish the contents or integrity of data exchanged inside the HTTPS tunnels.
The logs do not establish whether the updater executable or its installed files were independently verified as authentic.
The other recorded endpoint events do not, on their own, establish malicious activity or a connection to the periodic ChartMate traffic.
